module: Small normal computation utility for the points of a rally snaproad. From a point with prev/next links, it computes the "forward" normal vector using the available neighbors (rallyUtil.calculateForwardNormal).

normalAlignPoints.desc: Returns the triplet (previous point, current point, next point) of a point; returns nil, nil, nil if the point is nil.

point.desc: Point with prev and next fields (and pos)

forwardNormalVec.desc: Computes the point's forward normal. Uses prev→next if both exist, otherwise current→next, otherwise prev→current; returns nil if no neighbor exists.

point.desc: Point with pos, prev and next

returns.desc: Normal vector built from the x, y, z of the result of rallyUtil.calculateForwardNormal
